regime_assessment.summary: Broad energy and industrial commodity spike as of Mar 6; oil/gas/refined products and polymers up sharply. Classification requires curve structure, inventories, export pace, cross-commodity confirmation and COT—not in snapshot.

notes: Snapshot shows large weekly/monthly moves consistent with either risk premium or real tightness.
Futures curve (backwardation vs contango) not provided.
Export pace / shipment disruptions not in snapshot.
Until 6-variable checklist is filled, treat as transition.

triggers.red: USDVND +3.0% vs 3M avg OR > 2σ move in 20d

metrics: Top-tier 12M retail deposit rate (system average proxy)
Direction (Δ in last 4 weeks and 8 weeks)

triggers.momentum: +25 bps in 4 weeks (watch); +50 bps in 8 weeks (risk)

decision_rules.if: Any channel moves from calm to watch

then_sector_bias.notes: Monitor; no rotation yet; tighten risk on rate-sensitive and high leverage.

decision_rules.if: One or more channels at risk or red (CPI and/or FX and/or deposit_rates and/or money_market)

then_sector_bias.notes: Commodity shock + macro stress; rotate toward beneficiaries; avoid rate-sensitive and leverage.

decision_rules.if: FX and deposit_rates and money_market all below watch (calm)

then_sector_bias.notes: Broaden selectively to banks, brokers, consumer, real estate as regime allows; no forced rotation.

decision_rules.if: CPI at red (>= 5% YoY) with FX or deposit_rates at risk/red

then_sector_bias.notes: Full transmission; defensive tilt toward commodity beneficiaries and away from CPI-squeezed and rate-sensitive.

beneficiaries.mechanism: Higher oil/gas prices support day-rates and utilization; upstream capex and activity demand.
Wider crack spreads and refining margins; inventory gains possible.
Pass-through of higher gasoline/diesel; margin depends on cost vs selling price timing.
Higher gas/LPG prices can support revenue; cost pass-through and contract mix matter.
Freight index up; higher rates support revenue if volumes hold.
Throughput-driven; higher freight can coincide with volume.

invalidation: Rates collapse with no volume offset

beneficiaries.mechanism: Oil up → synthetic rubber cost up → potential substitution toward natural rubber; needs price confirmation.
Safe-haven bid and inventory revaluation; demand elasticity risk.

losers.mechanism: Polyethylene/PP/PVC up sharply; input cost rise without pass-through squeezes margin.
Jet fuel cost; demand risk under macro stress.
Deposit rate up and liquidity tight → funding cost and demand pressure.

mixed.why_mixed: Depend on input spreads (sulfur, NH3) and inventory timing; sulfur up sharply.
what_to_check: DAP price and spread vs NH3+sulfur
